definitions.explanation: An electrical kitchen appliance designed to cook rice automatically.

examples.english: Cook rice in a rice cooker.

notes:
An essential appliance in Japanese households. Types:
- ⟦マイコン→マイコン：30520_maikon⟧⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ (microcomputer-controlled) - basic, affordable
- IH⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ (induction heating) - even heating, better quality
- ⟦{圧力|あつりょく}→圧力：12014_atsuryoku⟧IH⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧ (pressure IH) - premium, fluffier rice
- ⟦{土鍋|どなべ}→土鍋：07949_donabe⟧IH (clay pot IH) - mimics traditional cooking

Features:
- ⟦{保温|ほおん}→保温：17467_hoon⟧ (keep warm)
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦{炊飯|すいはん}→炊飯：13377_suihan⟧ (timer/scheduled cooking)
- ⟦{早炊|はやだ}き→早炊き：30521_hayadaki⟧ (quick cook)
- ⟦{玄米|げんまい}→玄米：06100_genmai⟧モード (brown rice mode)
- ⟦おかゆ→お粥：16857_okayu⟧モード (porridge mode)

Major Japanese brands: ⟦{象印|ぞうじるし}→象印：noentry⟧ (Zojirushi), ⟦タイガー→タイガー：noentry⟧ (Tiger), ⟦パナソニック→パナソニック：noentry⟧ (Panasonic), ⟦{日立|ひたち}→日立：noentry⟧ (Hitachi), ⟦{三菱|みつびし}→三菱：noentry⟧ (Mitsubishi).

Capacity measured in ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧: ⟦{三合炊|さんごうだ}き→三合炊き：noentry⟧ (3 cups), ⟦{五合炊|ごごうだ}き→五合炊き：noentry⟧ (5 cups), etc. A ⟦{五合炊|ごごうだ}き→五合炊き：noentry⟧ model is the standard size for a family.
